sloka: शरभंग आश्रमम् पुण्यम् आजगाम पुरंदरः ।आनीतः त्वम् इमम् देशम् उपायेन महर्षिभिः ॥३-३०-३५॥
transliteration: śarabhaṁga āśramam puṇyam ājagāma puraṁdaraḥ ।ānītaḥ tvam imam deśam upāyena maharṣibhiḥ ॥3-30-35॥

translations.english: 'In a little more than half a moment of this great war Rama had accomplished the terrific task of killing with sharp darts fourteen thousand demons, led by Khara and Dusana.
